These are concrete matrices, not arbitrary block operators supplied by a query evaluator. The potential is f_A(x) = (1/2) x^T A x, and exact FO_A(x) is the ordered value-and-gradient pair ((1/2)x^T A x, A x). The source target is the centered Gaussian N(0,A^{-1}), but no distributional conclusion is selected here. Primitive oracle O_boldO(j,v,f) = O_j v; O_boldO(j,v,i) = transpose(O_j) v. Inverse means transpose of this orthogonal block. Query x=(x_1,...,x_k,z); each unknown block contributes g_j=((κ+1)/2)x_j-((κ-1)/4)(F_j+I_j), where F_j and I_j are the actual forward and inverse responses at the same input x_j.
